info.description: End-to-end + negative tests for Service Order Management API (FastAPI).

exec: pm.globals.set('qa_guard_required_uuid', "function qaGuardRequiredUuid(name) { const value = (pm.environment.get(name) || '').trim(); pm.test(name + ' is populated', function () { pm.expect(value, name + ' must be set by a previous request').to.match(/^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$/); }); return value; }");

pm.globals.set('qa_parse_json', `function qaParseJson() { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { pm.test('response is valid JSON', function () { throw new Error('Response body is not valid JSON: ' + pm.response.text()); }); throw error; } }`);
